target: superfluid TOGA PIC seat (USDCx): post a bond to receive the patrician-period stream liquidation rewards
why: needs_human: a risk-rule exception, not a service. Mechanism pays and is open to anyone: whoever holds the PIC seat of a super token in TOGA 0xA87F76e99f6C8Ff8996d14f550ceF47f193D9A09 receives the deposit of every stream liquidated in its first 30 critical minutes. Base USDCx (0xD04383398dD2426297da660F9CCA3d439AF9ce1b) paid 113.69 USDCx in 28 days (weeks 10.84 / 0.50 / 81.75 / 20.60, 44 events, Superfluid subgraph) = at most 4.06 USD/day, against a bond of 85-110 USDCx. Critical times are known hours to weeks ahead (subgraph maybeCriticalAtTimestamp), so it is a scheduled type, not a block race; the contest is a last-bid capital contest with one incumbent (0xac8f348159417a7caa4db74ee2071946dc64ea35, bid 101.49 USDCx 181 s before an 8.22 USDCx liquidation: tx 0xfd2ba016..., 0x02912ea5...). Fork-proven that a stranger can take the seat and gets the full bond back in the tx that outbids it (attempts row of run 56e8c1ce, scratch/sf_fork_proof.py). What it needs: the bond (about 90-400 USD of USDC wrapped 1:1 to USDCx) leaves the wallet in one tx and comes back only as a stream over >= 7 days (max exit rate = bond / 604,800 s) or at once when a rival outbids. That breaks L (balance must end higher in the same tx) and the holding frame (one-tx exit to USDC at any time, holding_usd <= 100). Capital needed: 120-400 USD; EV at that capital: 0-4 USD/day (upper bound = every Base USDCx reward; share against the incumbent unknown until tried). Loss cases: gas only when outbid (measured: full bond returned); sender tops up before the critical time = no reward and the bond idles until streamed back; Superfluid contract risk on the bond.
